---
title: "Development process"
---

## Our approach

POPCORN-NCD is being developed following the [EQUATOR Network](https://www.equator-network.org) methodology for reporting guideline development. This rigorous, internationally-recognized approach ensures:

- **Evidence-based content** through systematic scoping reviews
- **International consensus** via multi-round e-Delphi surveys
- **Diverse perspectives** from researchers, editors, and knowledge users
- **Transparent development** with open sharing of materials and progress
- **Broad applicability** across geographical regions and model types

### ✅ Step 1: Establish the Scientific Advisory Group {#step-1}

**Status:** Complete

#### Objectives

- Agree on the reporting guideline scope
- Provide ongoing guidance on development and implementation strategy

#### What we did

Our Scientific Advisory Group brings together international expertise in:

- Diverse geographical regions
- Various modelling approaches and methodologies
- Multiple stakeholder perspectives (researchers, editors, policymakers)

The group has:

- Established the guideline scope and development strategy
- Planned the scoping review approach
- Provided ongoing guidance on methodology and implementation

#### Deliverables

- Scientific Advisory Group membership finalized ([view members →](team.qmd#strategic-advisory-committee))
- Scope statement approved
- Development protocol outlined

**Last updated:** [TO BE ADDED]

---

### ⏳ Step 2: Generate candidate reporting guideline checklist items {#step-2}

**Status:** In progress

#### Objectives

- Conduct scoping reviews to extract relevant items for e-Delphi
- Review candidate items to establish the organization, completeness, and redundancy of the candidate items list

#### What we're doing

**Scoping review 1: Existing reporting guidelines and frameworks**

- Systematic search for reporting guidelines, quality assessment tools, and best practice frameworks relevant to simulation modelling
- Extraction of candidate checklist items from identified resources
- Synthesis and categorization of items by reporting domain

**Scoping review 2: Published simulation modelling studies**

- Sample of recent NCD simulation modelling studies across journals and model types
- Assessment of what information is currently being reported
- Identification of gaps and variability in reporting practices

**Review and synthesis**

The Scientific Advisory Group will:

- Review all candidate items extracted from scoping reviews
- Eliminate redundancy and consolidate similar items
- Organize items into logical reporting domains
- Ensure coverage of all critical model components
- Prepare candidate list for e-Delphi evaluation

#### Current progress

- [ ] Scoping review 1: Item extraction in progress

- Scoping review reports
- Candidate checklist items for e-Delphi

### ⏺ Step 3: Perform the international e-Delphi survey {#step-3}

**Status:** Planned - recruitment not yet open

#### Objectives

- Recruit, screen, and register international participants for the e-Delphi survey
- Conduct a two-round evaluation of candidate items

#### Planned activities

**Participant recruitment**

We will recruit international participants representing:

- **Modelling researchers:** Authors of NCD simulation modelling studies
- **Journal editors:** Editors handling modelling manuscripts
- **Peer reviewers:** Reviewers with modelling expertise
- **Knowledge users:** Policymakers and decision-makers who use model results
- **Methodological experts:** Statisticians, health economists, epidemiologists

**Two-round e-Delphi process**

**Round 1:**

- Participants rate each candidate item on importance and clarity
- Open-ended feedback on wording, missing items, and organization
- Analysis of agreement and feedback themes

**Round 2:**

- Participants review Round 1 results (anonymized)
- Re-rate items that didn't reach consensus
- Evaluate modified items based on Round 1 feedback
- Assess organization and structure of checklist

**Analysis:**

- Quantitative: Agreement percentages, stability of ratings
- Qualitative: Thematic analysis of open-ended comments
- Synthesis: Items for consensus meeting discussion

#### How to participate

Recruitment will open in [TIMEFRAME].

[Sign up for notifications →](get-involved.qmd#delphi-interest)

#### Deliverables (planned)

- e-Delphi recruitment materials
- e-Delphi survey instruments (rounds 1 and 2)
- Summary of e-Delphi results (anonymized)
- List of items achieving consensus
- List of items requiring consensus meeting discussion

### ⏺ Step 4: Conduct consensus and writing meetings {#step-4}

**Status:** Planned

#### Objectives

- Obtain expert consensus on the final list of checklist items
- Develop the reporting guideline with checklist, explanation and elaboration document, and implementation tools

#### Planned activities

**Consensus meeting**

- Meeting with Scientific Advisory Group and invited experts
- Review e-Delphi results and discuss items without consensus
- Finalize checklist item wording and organization
- Agree on structure of explanation and elaboration document
- Plan implementation tools (templates, examples, tutorials)

**Writing and review**

Draft materials to be developed:

- POPCORN-NCD checklist
- Explanation and elaboration (E&E) document with:
  - Detailed guidance for each checklist item
  - Examples of good reporting from published studies
  - Common pitfalls and how to avoid them
  - Rationale and evidence supporting each item
- Implementation tools:
  - Manuscript submission template
  - Peer reviewer checklist
  - Author self-assessment tool
  - Reporting examples by model type

**External review**

- Share draft materials with broader stakeholder groups
- Incorporate feedback and finalize documents
- Prepare for publication and dissemination

### ⏺ Step 5: Disseminate the reporting guideline {#step-5}

**Status:** Planned

#### Objectives

- Make the reporting guideline available to all stakeholder groups and publish it in an open-access journal with an open license
- Engage with researchers and support the adoption of the reporting guideline

#### Planned activities

**Publication strategy**

- Submit POPCORN-NCD statement to high-impact open-access journal
- Publish explanation and elaboration document (same or companion journal)
- Make all materials freely available on this website and OSF.io

**Dissemination channels**

- **Academic:** Conference presentations, journal clubs, webinars
- **Journals:** Encourage editorial adoption and author guidelines updates
- **Policy:** Engage knowledge user networks and decision-maker forums
- **Public:** Press release, social media, lay summary
- **Educational:** Integrate into graduate curricula and training programs

**Implementation support**

- Develop training materials (slide decks, videos, tutorials)
- Host workshops and webinars for researchers and editors
- Create examples and case studies demonstrating application
- Establish support channels for questions and feedback
- Monitor adoption and gather user feedback

**Long-term maintenance**

Periodic review and updates based on:

- User feedback and implementation challenges
- Evolution of modelling methods
- Emergence of new model types or applications
- Potential development of extensions for specific contexts

#### Deliverables (planned)

- Published POPCORN-NCD statement (open access)
- Published explanation and elaboration document (open access)
- Website with all materials freely downloadable
- Training and implementation resources
- Dissemination plan and tracking
